title: GET /rest/saiku/session must not return the servlet session id (authid) — the session cookie is HttpOnly, so the JSON body must not hand the same value to script

criteria.then: the response body contains no authid key — and therefore no value equal to the (HttpOnly) JSESSIONID cookie, whose id was the only thing ever stored under that key
the session response still identifies the caller (username and sessionid present), so stripping the servlet session id does not empty the session

steps.name: the session response carries no authid

authid.because: authid held the servlet session id, the same value the HttpOnly JSESSIONID cookie carries; script must never be able to read it

steps.name: the session response still identifies the caller
